title: Webflow definition
description: Container object for a complete Preside webflow definition

version.description: Version number of the schema to validate against (i.e. this document)

webflow.description: Container object for the webflow definition

id.description: Unique identifier for the webflow template

feature.description: Preside feature that must be enabled in order for this flow to be registered

singleton.description: Whether or not more than one configured instance of this flow can exist, or not.

adminFlow.description: Whether or not this flow is for admin purpose only, or not.

hideFromWidget.description: Whether or not this flow is hide from widget, or not.

meta.description: Abitrary struct of metadata to describe/enhance the webflow definition

layout.description: Explicit webflow layout viewlet in which to display steps

preCancelHandler.description: Handler action that is triggered before a webflow instance is cancelled.

postCancelHandler.description: Handler action that is triggered after a webflow instance is cancelled.

instRefConfig.description: Configuration related to webflow instance reference.

steps.description: The steps of the flow. Any webflow must have at least two steps.
